context: 2.16.1 pre-tag review round: workflow stalled on all 24 attempts, review completed inline from salvaged executed evidence + own attack list; 4 findings fixed with tests (falsy-scalar bodies counted, validator backend-aware + unreadable paths, log wording)
rationale: readRecord now returns undefined only on read/parse failure so the caller can distinguish 'parsed to null' from 'unparseable'; this makes ingest agree with validate-records, which already classified those bodies as non_string_id, and makes the CHANGELOG's 'silent branch is now counted and warned' claim true for every class
summary: Chose to treat a JSON body that parses to a falsy scalar (null/false/0/"") as a missing-id file in ingest (counted in skipped + warned, row retained) rather than leaving it silently skipped
